# VitraCare — full context

> VitraCare installs custom window film and tint in Brussels and its surroundings, for homes and businesses (offices, shops, co-ownerships): privacy (mirror effect or matte white film), thermal comfort (solar film), UV protection against fading, and added security (anti-break-in film). Free quote, reply within 24 hours.

VitraCare acts as a commercial intermediary: first contact, advice and the quote are handled by VitraCare, installation is carried out by an independent contractor. Based in Brussels, Belgium. Trilingual site: French (default), Dutch (/nl) and English (/en).

Other language versions: [Français](https://vitracare.be/llms-full.txt) — [Nederlands](https://vitracare.be/nl/llms-full.txt)

## The 4 films in detail

### Mirror effect film (silver or black)
Full daytime privacy: creates a one-way mirror effect that fully blocks the view from outside during the day, while you keep a clear view from inside. Also reduces heat and blocks up to 87% of UV depending on the intensity installed (46% light version, 87% strong version). The effect reverses in the evening if the interior is brighter than outside — normal behaviour, not a fault. Black version: privacy even at night with the interior lit, at the cost of reduced interior brightness (better suited to a glazed front door than a living room).

### Solar tint
Stays transparent in both directions (slight blue tint). Reduces heat and glare without darkening the room. UV protection as a bonus. No effect on privacy. Best suited for conservatories, offices, and south/west-facing living rooms, computer screens.

### Matte white film
Full privacy in both directions, day AND night — unlike mirror effect film. Blurs the view from both sides. Ideal for bathrooms, ground-floor bedrooms, glazed front doors.

### Anti-burglary film
Fully transparent. Doesn't make the window unbreakable, but keeps glass shards stuck to the film instead of letting them fall on impact, which significantly slows down and complicates a break-in attempt.

All compatible with single/double/triple glazing, can be combined on the same project, installed on the interior side (exterior installation available depending on preference), estimated lifespan 10 to 15 years, 2-year warranty on installation.

## Pricing

No fixed price displayed: the rate depends on the type of film, the total surface area and the accessibility of the windows. Every project gets a free, personalised quote with no obligation, reply within 24 hours. The home visit and measurements are free in Brussels (€50 outside).

## Service area

Brussels-Capital Region and its 19 municipalities, Walloon and Flemish Brabant. Can travel elsewhere in Belgium (Charleroi, Antwerp, Ghent) for large enough projects.

## Frequently asked questions

**How does a quote request work?** You send your measurements and a few photos of your windows for a quick initial estimate. For larger projects, VitraCare can also visit to confirm the measurements on site.

**Do you have a showroom?** No, no physical showroom currently. The "Our work" page shows real projects already completed.

**What guarantee do you offer?** 2 years on the installation, covering a defect linked to the installation itself (peeling, a bubble). Doesn't cover damage caused afterwards by misuse or a third party.

**Who carries out the installation?** An independent contractor working with VitraCare, who together with VitraCare remains the client's single point of contact before and after the work.

**Am I committed to anything after a quote?** No, the quote is free and comes with no obligation.

**How can I stop neighbours or passers-by from seeing into my home?** Mirror effect film is the most widely used solution: blocks the view from outside during the day without closing curtains or shutters. For privacy at all times, including in the evening, matte white film is the alternative.

**Does the film protect against heat and UV?** Yes, up to 87% of UV blocked depending on intensity, and a significant reduction in heat during summer. A heat-retention effect in winter is theoretically possible but not scientifically proven for these films.

**Do you install on all types of glazing?** Yes, single, double and triple glazing.

**Is it legal to tint windows in Belgium?** Yes, fully legal, for houses or flats. Check the co-ownership regulations case by case for a flat (the film doesn't change the building's exterior appearance).

**Can film be applied to windows that are already installed?** Yes, one of the main advantages: direct installation on existing windows, with no removal or replacement of the glazing, in a single visit.

**Does anti-burglary film prevent a break-in?** No, no film makes a window unbreakable. It significantly slows down an attempt by keeping shards stuck to the film, which complicates and delays entry.

**How do I clean a window with film on it?** With water and mild soap only. Standard chemical products (ammonia, alcohol) can damage the film. Avoid cleaning or touching the window for the month following installation, to let the film fully adhere.

**Does the price depend on the size of the windows?** Yes, mainly on the total glass surface area and the film chosen — hence always a personalised quote rather than a fixed price.

**Replacing windows or installing film: what's the difference?** Replacing is more durable but significantly more costly (major work, removal). Film is applied to existing windows, with no major work, for a fraction of the price — relevant when the windows are still in good condition and the need is privacy/heat/security rather than an insulation problem with the glazing itself.
